props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: SCRAM-SHA-256 enforcement: SP-Controlled IAM (iscf-ia-01) mandates strong auth; AI Usage Logging (iscf-ai-04) covers auth event traceability. Enforced via Helm ConfigMap.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: No anonymous access: SP-Controlled IAM (iscf-ia-01) prohibits unauthenticated sessions; No Standing Vendor Access (iscf-ia-02) ensures no anonymous standing sessions. Verified via Concert API user scan.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: x.509 replica set auth: Approved Cryptographic Algorithms (iscf-cr-03) governs x.509 cipher use; Mandatory Encryption in Transit (iscf-dr-07) requires TLS for all intra-cluster traffic. Enforced via Compliance Operator TLS cert check.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: TLS 1.2+ on all connections: Approved Cipher Algorithms (iscf-cr-03) defines TLS cipher policy; Mandatory Encryption in Transit (iscf-dr-07) requires TLS; AI/Workload Network Isolation (iscf-ai-03) enforces no unencrypted egress.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: WiredTiger encryption at rest: SP-Controlled Keys (iscf-cr-01) governs KMIP key used by WiredTiger; Mandatory Encryption at Rest (iscf-dr-06) requires storage encryption; AI/Workload Network Isolation (iscf-ai-03) ensures encrypted storage nodes are sovereign.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: Key rotation < 365 days: Cryptographic Config Validation (iscf-cr-04) validates key age against approved rotation period; Sovereign Patch and Vulnerability Management (iscf-op-04) governs key lifecycle remediation timelines. Verified via Concert API and KMIP script.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: auditLog destination set: Account Lifecycle Monitoring (iscf-ia-04) requires auth event logging; Sovereignty Exception Management (iscf-gov-03) relies on audit trail; Metadata Telemetry Residency (iscf-dr-10) ensures logs stay sovereign.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: Admin operations logged: Account Lifecycle Monitoring (iscf-ia-04) requires all privilege events logged; Sovereignty Risk Acceptance (iscf-gov-02) requires audit evidence; AI Usage Logging (iscf-ai-04) captures all usage decisions.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: Log retention >= 90 days: Regional Sovereignty Control Ownership (iscf-gov-01) sets retention policy authority; Sovereign Monitoring Stack (iscf-mi-01) enforces sovereign log retention within the approved region. Verified via Compliance Operator log volume and policy check.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: VM lifecycle events logged: Account Lifecycle Monitoring (iscf-ia-04) covers VM provisioning events; Regional Sovereignty Control Ownership (iscf-gov-01) mandates audit accountability for VM lifecycle.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: bindIp restricted: Network Egress Sovereignty (iscf-dr-03) controls outbound exposure; AI/Workload Network Isolation (iscf-ai-03) enforces no uncontrolled external exposure from workloads.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: NetworkPolicy blocks external: Network Egress Sovereignty (iscf-dr-03); Inter-Namespace Data Flow Control (iscf-dr-04) restricts lateral movement; Cross-Tenant Exposure Prevention (iscf-dr-09) ensures namespace isolation.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: No external egress: Derived/Temporary Data Residency (iscf-dr-02) prevents derived data leaving sovereign boundary; Network Egress Sovereignty (iscf-dr-03) enforces default-deny egress.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: Least-privilege DB roles: SP-Controlled IAM (iscf-ia-01) governs role assignment policy; Cross-Tenant Exposure Prevention (iscf-dr-09) requires DB-level isolation between tenants. Verified via Concert API DB user role scan.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: No root role in production: SP-Controlled IAM (iscf-ia-01) prohibits over-privileged roles; No Standing Vendor Access (iscf-ia-02) ensures no permanent root-level access. Verified via Concert API role membership scan.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: OCP ServiceAccount RBAC: SP-Controlled IAM (iscf-ia-01) governs ServiceAccount identity and role assignment.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: Operator access audit: SP-Controlled IAM (iscf-ia-01) governs operator identity; Sovereign Break-Glass Access Governance (iscf-ia-03) requires all admin sessions to be time-bound and auditable.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: virt-launcher pod non-root: SP-Controlled IAM (iscf-ia-01) governs pod identity; Cross-Tenant Exposure Prevention (iscf-dr-09) requires process isolation between VM workloads.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: VM boot image signed and verified: Image Signing Enforcement (iscf-sc-02) requires cryptographic signatures on all deployed VM images; Approved Cryptographic Algorithms (iscf-cr-03) governs the signing algorithm. Verified via ArgoCD image signature policy and Concert API.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: Guest OS RHEL CIS hardened: Network Egress Sovereignty (iscf-dr-03) is enforced by OS-level firewall rules on the guest; Automated Config Baseline Enforcement (iscf-sc-04) continuously validates the CIS Level 1 baseline via Compliance Operator.

props.name: mapping-rationale
props.value: CPACF hardware crypto active: Approved Cryptographic Algorithms (iscf-cr-03) requires hardware-accelerated encryption where available on IBM Z; AI/Workload Network Isolation (iscf-ai-03) relies on hardware crypto for sovereign workload encryption.
